_how_to_use: Copy to decks/<your-slug>.json and rewrite the text. «guillemets» mark every slot to fill — --final refuses to build while any remain. *asterisks* make ONE phrase amber, one per slide. Types: cover, text, stat, steps, compare, quote, cta — delete what you don't need. 6-8 slides. One problem, one number, one fix. Full notes in tools/carousel/README.md.
